definitions.explanation: The time when night ends and day begins; the break of day.

definitions.gloss: end of a period, beginning of a new era
definitions.explanation: The point at which a period or season ends and transitions into the next phase. Used for the end of the rainy season, the new year, and similar transitions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜明|よあ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧。
{明|あ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{染|そ}まっていた→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: The dawn sky was dyed red.

examples.japanese: {明|あ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明星|みょうじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The morning star was shining in the eastern sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨明|つゆあ}け→梅雨明け：08338_tsuyuake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm waiting for the end of the rainy season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年明|としあ}け→年明け：12476_toshiake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}いましょう→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: Let's meet after the new year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧{明|あ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまって⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: Work piles up after the long holiday, so it's tough.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form of the verb {明|あ}ける (to dawn, to open). In sense 1, most commonly appears in the compound ⟦{夜明|よあ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧ (dawn, daybreak). In sense 2, it forms many useful compounds:

- ⟦{梅雨明|つゆあ}け→梅雨明け：08338_tsuyuake⟧: end of the rainy season
- ⟦{年明|としあ}け→年明け：12476_toshiake⟧: the new year, after the new year
- ⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧{明|あ}け: after a long holiday
- ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧{明|あ}け: after New Year's
- {夏休|なつやす}み{明|あ}け: after summer vacation

The sense 2 pattern 〜{明|あ}け is very productive and means "right after the end of ~."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{夜明|よあ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧: dawn, daybreak
- ⟦{梅雨明|つゆあ}け→梅雨明け：08338_tsuyuake⟧: end of rainy season
- ⟦{年明|としあ}け→年明け：12476_toshiake⟧: new year
- {明|あ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明星|みょうじょう}: the morning star (Venus)
